purpose: Idle containers sleep (cgroup freezer pause, or stop) and wake on a connection, `powos containers wake|start`, or an app opening them (docs/PHONE-KERNEL-CONTAINERS.md section 13).
processes: one watcher (`powos-container autosleep watch`, root, the system tier's mount namespace), started on demand by powos containers, gone 10 min after the last container; on exit or failure it thaws every container it paused
limits: a /proc scan every 30 s and epoll in between (no polling of sockets); ~1 nsenter `cmd settings` call per scan on the phone (battery saver, ~30 ms)
